name: UPLAND 阿普兰 R70
why_interesting: The current exact R70 page supplies a manufacturer weight claim and full Di2 build, while current official-store indexes also expose mechanical 105 builds. The retained cards do not select one drivetrain.

facts.listing_identity: UPLAND / 阿普兰 R70 complete-bike family
facts.complete_weight: The exact manufacturer page search-index excerpt returned 2026-09-23 claims approximately 8.3 kg bare, excluding pedals and computer mount, for the displayed 105 Di2 build. Direct opening timed out; retained cards do not select this build, and size/weighing method are unstated.
facts.drivetrain_options: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2x12 and Shimano 105 R7170/R7150 Di2 2x12 are both current
facts.stock_tire: Michelin Dynamic Sport 700x25C on the displayed manufacturer build; maximum clearance unpublished
facts.frame_material: Toray T700 carbon main frame with T800 reinforcement at key areas and a T800 carbon fork
facts.identity_source: Exact UPLAND product page and race article identify the R70; the current product page was available only as a search-index excerpt because direct opening timed out. The pages do not map retained seller cards to one drivetrain option.
facts.stiffness_evidence: Independent exact-model review reports strong pedaling stiffness; current manufacturer engineering notes describe T800 reinforcement for structural strength, but no instrumented frame-stiffness protocol is published
